Contrast is the difference in light between text and what sits behind it. WCAG measures it as a ratio, from 1:1 for none to 21:1 for black on white. Body text needs 4.5:1; large text and graphics need 3:1.

AA Large

Text from 24px, or from 19px bold: headlines and display type. WCAG 1.4.3.

AAA Large

The enhanced level for large text. WCAG 1.4.6.

 4.5:1 –{{icon:check}}{{icon:close}}
Graphics

Icons, chart marks, input borders and focus rings need 3:1 against what sits beside them. WCAG 1.4.11.

 3:1 –{{icon:check}}{{icon:close}}
